description: Verified small-memory eight-node LEGOSim-SimBricks Docker Swarm profile for fixed-process-count 1/2/4/8 placement experiments.
operational_notes: The profile assigns 8 vCPUs and 12 GiB of guest RAM in total; reserve additional host memory for VMware, Docker, cache, and Windows.
Target VMs must be powered off before applying resource changes. The script verifies by default and never powers off VMs automatically.
MAC addresses, UUIDs, disks, NoCloud seeds, and credentials are host-local state and are not versioned.
The 1, 2, 4, and 8 node experiments reuse these eight VMs; node count changes only Swarm placement.
